title: Brand Guidelines
slide_intent: Introduce the book and its owner so a reader can identify the reference at a glance.
strategic_value: The small circuit-pad signature can identify Voltera while the larger title establishes the purpose of the document.
demonstration: A small Voltera signature and the white title share a left edge within a centered block on a dark ground.
practical_value: Use the size difference between the signature and title when introducing an official publication.

content_islands.name: Corporate signature
content_islands.spec: Place the blue-and-white pad mark and white wordmark above the title.

content_islands.name: Book title
content_islands.spec: Set Brand Guidelines on a single line below the signature. Leave a wide dark field around the block.
